name: LocalGov Content Lock
description: Customises the Content Lock module for use with LocalGov Drupal.
project_description: Customises the Content Lock module for use with LocalGov Drupal. It is a thin glue module: it depends on Content Lock (drupal/content_lock ^3.0), and on install it turns on pessimistic locking for every node bundle by writing types.node = ['*' => '*'] into content_lock.settings. It also adds a 'Locked content' link to the admin content page (a local task tab) and the admin menu, both pointing at Content Lock's view.locked_content.page_1 listing. The module ships no configuration UI of its own; the lock timeout (default 30 minutes) and other behaviour are managed on Content Lock's own settings page at /admin/config/content/content_lock.
